articleTitle: A Low-Cost Industrial Automation System Using IoT and Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The IoT, or internet of things, is a technique that utilises devices like computers to remotely manage physical objects. Here, we suggest an effective approach for automating the industrial sector that would enable users to effectively operate industrial machinery and appliances online. The Internet of Things (IoT) is a network of interconnected objects that are built with hardware, software, actuators, sensors, and network connectivity. This technology allows these things to gather and share data. With the help of the IoT, we are creating a system in this article that will constantly detect industrial applications and provide alerts, alarms, or intelligent judgments. Using mobile technologies like Android and sensors, the IoT has provided us with a potential approach to develop robust industrial applications and systems. The most important thing this review paper adds is a summary of IoT applications in sectors where AI is used to monitor and run the sector.

articleTitle: Fundamental Issue for Wind Power Systems Operating at Variable Wind Speeds: the Dependence of the Optimal Angular Speed on the Wind Speed
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This work addresses a fundamental issue that arises at maximal wind energy capture: understanding the relationship between the optimal speed and wind speed. The maximum amount of wind energy is not captured by wind turbines because they are calibrated for specific meteorological conditions and mechanical demands (air density of a certain value, plastic deformations of the pallets), which are constantly changing. The dependence of the optimal mechanical angular speed on wind speed needs to be periodically recalculated in order to ensure maximum wind energy capture. This is done by determining the wind turbine's maximum given power and highlighting the wind system's energy efficiency at varying wind speeds over time. The optimal mechanical angular speed's relationship to wind speed can be calculated using experimental data. Based on experimental data from wind turbines in the Dobrogea region, the results were attained.

Author Keywords: value of total moment of inertia
dependency speeds angle mechanical eighth of speed wind data experimental

articleTitle: A Remote Laboratory for Linear Electronics Based on the Red Pitaya Board
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Developing high-quality engineering study programs that can meet individual requirements, offer flexible study pathways, and provide simple and quick access to the most relevant educational facilities and lecturers is a vital and demanding problem for engineering education's future. The laboratory is an important component of engineering and applied science education. The emergence of virtual and remote laboratories was unavoidable with the development of the Internet and connecting IT technologies. From the perspective of students, it is a valuable resource not only for those enrolled in distance or online courses but also for those who prefer to study in a traditional setting. Students can now expand or restructure their study time thanks to the widespread availability of smart, portable devices that can connect to the internet. This is a huge help to them, as it allows them to divide their time and learn how to study independently. This self-directed approach can help them prepare for the workplace. It provides students with flexibility and convenience. From the perspective of universities, it helps reduce maintenance costs and allows universities to share experiments, which benefits educational institutions with limited resources.

articleTitle: Automatic Redundant Power Supply System for the Dynamic Braking System, Used for the Quick and Controlled Stopping of Wound-Rotor Asynchronous Power Motors, Specific to the High Power Testing Laboratories
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Starting from the importance of fast and controlled braking of wound-rotor asynchronous motors, specific to high power testing laboratories, this article proposes an automatic redundant system for the dynamic braking system, used to stop under maximum safety conditions the asynchronous power motors, which use a hybrid photovoltaic panel system as main power source for charging the 240[V]DC/800[Ah] stationary battery, and an automatic three-phase rectifier as a redundant source. It describes the components, numerical simulations for the photovoltaic power system, as well as specific oscillograms during braking of asynchronous power motors in a High Power Testing Laboratories.

articleTitle: Detection of electric arc faults by Arc Fault Detection Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: In the last 30 years, new electrical devices capable of detecting the electric arc have been introduced. In the 90s the Arc Fault Circuit Interrupters were used in USA but lately such devices are widely used in Europe. At the moment, almost all electrical equipment manufacturers make their own version of such devices, called Arc Fault Detection Devices. These devices identify the fault signature of the undesired electric arc, produced in different configurations in respect to the circuit charge, and disconnect the circuit from the power supply according to specific demands. This means studying the symmetry of the current signal in relation to the sine waveform. At the same time, these devices must identify and allow the operation under normal conditions of some industrial devices inside which an electric arc occurs, such as drilling machines, cutting machines, etc. and allow their normal working without disconnection.This work proposes the study of the electrical parameters produced as a result of the normal working of some equipment (drilling machines, milling cutter, electric disc cutter), respectively produced as a fault in series with the circuit load. In the first case the waveform of the electric current is symmetric in relation to both half-periods of the supply signal, and in the second case it is asymmetric in relation to them. In this case the disconnection time was studied. For the tests there were used four Arc Fault Detection Devices with a nominal current of 16 Amps providing B or C tripping characteristics from three different producers.

articleTitle: Energy Management System for EV Charging Stations Powered by Renewable Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: A practical energy management system (EMS) for electric vehicle (EV) charging stations powered by renewable energy sources is proposed in this paper. The solution is flexible enough to be adapted either to prosumers, which typically include small photovoltaic (PV) power plants for self-consumption, or to dedicated PV-based EV charging stations. By using standard communication and protocols, the proposed EMS implements an algorithm that can be easily configured to operate with commercially available equipment (e.g. PV and battery inverters, EV charging stations) and to follow a certain optimization target according to the EV owner choice. The proposed EV charging EMS was experimentally tested using a system developed in a campus building, including a rooftop PV power plant, a Li-ion battery storage system and a level 2 EV charging station. The experimental results, covering 11 months of operation, validate the proposed EMS in real operating conditions.

articleTitle: A Solution for an Industrial Automation and SCADA System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The need to have increasingly reliable and effective systems led to the rapid development of SCADA systems, the systems that can be found everywhere today. SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) systems are used for supervise and control different industrial processes. One of these solutions is presented in this article. This solution includes the implementation of a platform for operating systems such as Windows XP, 7, S or 10, 11, but also for the porting of all the functionalities of this platform to the Windows Compact Embedded real-time operating system. The testing and evaluation of this solution led to its validation.

articleTitle: SPICE model of a real Zener diode tested at room temperature
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: In this work the study will start from the real equivalent circuit of a Zener diode and a model in SPICE will be created whose voltage varies with temperature and current. SPICE model verification will be studied at the temperature of 25°C. The study of the behavior of the SPICE model, taking into account the variation with temperature will be presented in a future paper. The behavior result of the proposed SPICE model is compared with the behavior of the real Zener diode and with the SPICE behavior of the Zener diode made in the SPICE library by the component manufacturer.

Author Keywords: the equivalent circuit for a real Zener diode

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Evaluation of the Quality Criteria of Educational Program in Field of Measuring Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper presents the results of a comparative analysis of the significance of the applied criteria for evaluation of the quality of educational program (EP). The analysis carried out relates to a group expert evaluation of the significance of the criteria and their sub-criteria for the EP in the field of measuring technology. A group expert evaluation was carried out by professors and the most qualified specialists of the Gheorghe Asachi Technical University of Iaşi(Romania) and several Ukrainian universities specializing in the field of measuring technology. For the evaluation, the same criteria and sub-criteria were used, as well as the same algorithm for processing the results. The received priorities of criteria and sub-criteria for two evaluations are analyzed. The criteria and sub-criteria that are important for the EP, established by two evaluations, are highlighted. Similarly, criteria and sub-criteria are highlighted that are not of significant importance for the EP, also identified by the two evaluations.

articleTitle: Group Expert Evaluation of the Quality Criteria of Educational Program in Field of Measuring Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper establishes the relevance of conducting research on the importance of the applied quality criteria of the educational program (EP). The approach to group expert assessment of the importance of criteria and their sub-criteria for EP in the field of measuring technology was investigated. The most qualified professors and specialists of the Gheorghe Asachi Technical University of Iasi specializing in the field of measuring technology are involved in such evaluation. To achieve the goal, the composition and requirements of the sub-criteria were analyzed, and an algorithm for group expert evaluation of the importance of the criteria and sub-criteria was proposed and substantiated. The priority of criteria and sub-criteria is established on the basis of the conducted evaluation. All established criteria (sub-criteria) for the EP must be used by universities. The most important and significantly affecting the quality of the EP criteria (sub-criteria), determined by the results of group expert evaluation, should be given special attention. Learning through research and recognition of learning outcomes of the EP are important criteria. It was established that such criteria include learning through research (C10) and recognition of learning outcomes (C3) of the EP.

articleTitle: Reactive Power Compensation at Industrial Consumers: Romanian Study Case
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper presents the results obtained at the end of a study which aim was to answer the question: What is the best solution for reactive power compensation in the case of industrial consumers? Reactive power compensation is an action needed to improve the operation of ac power systems. In the case of industrial consumers, the main goal of reactive power compensation is to increase their electrical system’s power factor that will benefit them economically and technically. The study had as support a Romanian industrial consumer, more specifically its electrical circuits’ structure, electrical equipment, active and reactive consumption, and power quality indices values. The first step of the study was to create a Simulink/MATLAB model for the industrial consumer. The next step was to analyze different technologies and equipment dedicated to reactive power compensation and to simulate diverse situations. The analysis of the results regarding the values of power factor could determine the best solution for the case study. The outcomes of the study were as follows: the use of capacitor banks is the simpler one, but it is not the best in case of fluctuating loads. The other solutions that imply the use of power electronic devices mean continuity in the compensation.

articleTitle: Low-Cost Power Quality System and Automatic Classification Disturbances Using SVM and DWT Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: It is a well-known fact that data acquisition in Power Quality (PQ) analysis is based on quality analyzers, the performance of which is standardized, but which have a relatively high purchase price. In this paper we present an equivalent low-cost data acquisition system based on a smart meter, plus the application software, which performs the main functions of a quality analyzer. Based on the acquired signals, we present the main PQ disturbances and their total harmonic distortion (THD) characteristics, but also the characteristics based on the Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) analysis, such as: entropy and signal energy. We present the training, testing and validation of an automatic classifier based on support vector machines (SVM) type algorithms that can be used for the automatic classification of PQ disturbances. We present the practical use of the data acquisition system and the automatic classification system by recognizing a sag-type PQ disturbance with harmonics, which is added to the main grid when coupling and uncoupling an uninterruptible power source (UPS).

articleTitle: Numerical Simulations and Experimental Tests for the Analysis of Capacitive Load Switching in Power Circuits
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper is dedicated to researching the occurrence of NSDDs, reignition and restrike in switchgear. Various experiments have been carried out illustrating the behavior of switchgear when interrupting capacitive loads. A large number of experiments show that when interrupting capacitive currents, this type of phenomena can occur randomly, and that after current interruption, the peak value of the transient recovery voltage is double the normal value. During the numerical simulations, through the usual modelling, the expected phenomena (reignition, restrike or NSDDs) were not evident, showing that these phenomena are strongly dependent on the design of the individual switchgear, the material of contacts, surface finish and cleanliness of the extinguishing medium.

articleTitle: Manufacturing of induction motors with Super Premium Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: In the context of increasing prices within the energy sector, one of the solutions is to reduce electricity consumption. In the EU alone, almost 50% of the produced electricity is consumed by electric motors. Thus, the transition to higher efficiency classes appears as a mandatory step. Nowadays, the induction motor manufacturers need to comply with more rigorous standards, such as IE4. This paper presents the efforts made by S.C. Electroprecizia Electrical Motors SRL Săcele to bring the efficiency of the induction motors in the Super Premium class. Details about the prototyping stages, applied technical solutions and obtained results in case of the 3kW2 pole pairs motor are provided in this paper.

articleTitle: The peculiarities of the steady state modes of medium voltage cables grid at various neutral grounding and single-phase to ground failure
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The work is devoted to the study of medium voltage cable line with isolated and compensated neutral in the MATLAB package. Some inherent patterns of voltage and current changes in the circuit are revealed when the damage resistance varies at different points of the line.

articleTitle: Cam Control Application with Simatic S7-1500T and Sinamics S210
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Mechanical cam is used especially for transforming the rotation motion of the disk cam into linear motion of the follower. One of the main problems of cam systems is the problem of optimal lubrication of the contact point and if an optimal lubrication is not obtained, that can lead to the shortening of the life of the machines due to excessive wear. A solution that uses two servo drives (SINAMICS S210) controlled by PLC (SIMATIC S7-1511T) to replace the cam-type mechanisms is presented in this article.

articleTitle: Contributions to the optimization of the Electrical Power Distribution in the Station Centru From Cluj, in the Context of Updating Its Medium Voltage Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The permanent updating of the distribution schemes, in accordance with changes of any kind (modernization, reservation, reliability, change of power line route, configuration and type, introduction of new consumers) is a necessity for both the distribution operator and for the other factors interested in the aspects related to the production, distribution and consumption of the electrical power. On the other hand, the determination of power and energy losses on the electrical network from an established areal and the consequent adoption of measures to reduce them are problems of utmost importance in the medium voltage (MV) networks operation and maintenance. In accordance with the aforementioned, this paper aims to improve the electric power distribution efficiency in the medium voltage (MV) network of the Centru power station from Cluj-Napoca urban area, in accordance with the following aspects: (1) to model the MV network in the context of changes that have recently occurred, respectively following the introduction of several new distributors and comparing it with the previous one and (2) to determine the effects of switching the rated voltage of the MV network from 10 kV to 20 kV.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Control of Electrical Sub Station Using IoT and Cloud
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The automation of power stations has become necessary for every electricity firm as the complexities of the distribution system have risen in order to boost profitability and increase the reliability of the electricity being supplied. The suggested project, which is IOT-based substation monitoring, would assist electricity companies in reducing the duration of intensity incursions by assuring that local-substation failures are quickly identified and communicated to the appropriate departments through IoT. For storage and safety, the data that is collected will be sent to the cloud. The microcontroller will perform a duty as specified in conjunction with the sensors placed at the neighbouring substation. If electrical characteristics such as current and voltage are regularly assessed to their rated value, distribution and power transformers will be protected from burns caused by overloading, short circuit failure, voltage fluctuations, and surges. Under these situations, the entire unit is forced to close by the control area, transfers included, detecting it, and momentarily disconnecting the external power source. The substation is smarter due to the Internet of Things since it can transmit and receive signals and data. This frees up time and allows the substation to cut labour costs. The sub-observational stations and operational efficacy will undoubtedly increase in this way.

articleTitle: Design of H∞ Robust Controllers for Wind Turbines Based on DFIG
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper describes the design and implementation of Hinfinity robust controllers for wind turbines using a Doubly-Fed Induction Generator (DFIG). Aspects of wind turbine modeling and robust control theoretical principles that ensure high performances under the existence of uncertainties model are presented. Although nonlinear models characterize wind turbines, for design the robust controller linearized models are used, depending on the operating point. Simulation results for closed loop systems obtained with H infinity robust controllers and optimized PID controllers are presented. In order to achieve high performances, the generator speed and pitch angle of the turbine are controlled. Comparative results of simulations, realized in Matlab are presented and show that the performance obtained with H infinity controllers is better than that obtained with PID controllers.

articleTitle: Power Quality Issues Generated by the Nonlinear Resonance Occurrence in Electric Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper investigates the main power quality issues initiated in a low-voltage power grid by the capacitive energization of various nonlinear magnetic devices (mainly, single-phase low-loaded transformers). The quantitatively study is performed by conducting a time-domain analysis of the transient state for the lumped-parameter equivalent circuit model. A suitable characterization of the magnetic nonlinear core of the device was selected and then the differential equations that describe the time circuit evolutions were numerically solved. The derived solutions were discretely examined by modern tools specific to dynamical systems theory (phase portrait representation, Poincaré map, etc.). Thus, the voltage and current waveforms time evolutions, their harmonic content, and the impact on to the network were highlighted. Supplementary, specific mitigations techniques to these power quality problems were also suggested and analyzed.

articleTitle: Metaheuristic Approaches for Distributed Generation Placement Optimization in Electrical Grids : A comparison between PSO, Tiki-Taka and Archimedes Optimzation Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Metaheuristic algorithms are being used extensively in the optimization of the planning, scheduling, and operation of electrical networks. Multiple studies carried out in the literature have shown that the performance of these methods depends on the particularities of the problem and the initial setup of the algorithm. This paper is testing the performance of two recent metaheuristic algorithms, the Tiki Taka Algorithm (TTA) and Archimedes optimization Algorithm (AOA), against the older Particle Swarm optimization (PSO), in solving the problem of optimal Distributed Generation (DG) placement in electricity distribution networks (EDN). A comparative case study highlights the particularities of each algorithm.

articleTitle: Power Systems Security Assessment Based on Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Power system security assessment is a major issue among the fundamental functions needed for the proper power systems operation. In order to perform the security evaluation, the contingency analysis is a key component. However, the dynamic evolution of power systems during the past decades led to the necessity of novel techniques to facilitate this task. In this paper, power systems security is defined based on the N-l contingency analysis. An artificial neural network approach is proposed to ensure the fast evaluation of power systems security. In this regard, the IEEE 14 bus transmission system is used to verify the performance of the proposed model, the results showing high efficiency subject to multiple evaluation metrics.

articleTitle: Predictive Method for Determining the Operating Condition of Big-Blaster Air Cannons Using Automatic Classification of Critical Discharge of Compressed Air
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Starting from the current requirements in industrial applications regarding the characterization and classification of the phenomenology of compressed air flow to sonic velocities in big-blaster type equipment, used for unblocking or cleaning of bunkers and silos with bulk/powder materials in cement and building material factories, coal-fired power plants, mining and steel industry, this paper presents a theoretical study of the discharge process of big-blaster equipment together with the automatic classification of each discharge by comparison with the presented theoretical results. The paper also describes the hardware and software structures of the automatic classification system, which additionally provides an automatic report and storage of the obtained results in special TDMS files or in MySQL database. Thus, we present a predictive maintenance method, which determines the operating condition of each big-blaster pneumatic cannon. The classification categories of the discharge phenomenon of big-blaster equipment obtained theoretically are validated by practical tests on a relatively large number of pieces of equipment from the range of air cannons mentioned above.

articleTitle: Electrical Engineering E-learning Education during COVID-19 Pandemic: Pedagogical and Psychological Aspects
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The aim of the paper is to discuss the online education experience of the students from Electrical Engineering. The study discusses the accumulation of information during pandemic by comparing the accumulation of online information to the system face to face from the personal perspective of the student, highlighting the benefits and difficulties.

articleTitle: Implementation of a PID Controller Using Siemens PLC
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Due to growth of the population, the demand for food has increased lately and will continue to do on the next years. In this context, one of the most important matters is the control and monitorization of the irrigation systems, which help agriculture to be more productive. Any pumping station depends on the flow that is delivered to the end users. The electrical cabinets in a pumping station contain frequency converters and soft starters that actuate the pumps electric motors. In this paper, the control of a pumping station is analyzed and implemented with the help of a PID controller, where the water pressure must be maintained at the value of 6 bars. In this case, a solution is proposed with a frequency converter that will maintain the pressure at the specified value and if the flow rate increases, then additional pumps will be started, operated by the soft starter. To operate a pump, at a given time, a selector will switch the pump to either the frequency converter or the soft starter. When the station is switched to automatic mode, it will not be allowed to change the pump from the frequency converter to the soft starter or vice versa. To maintain the reference pressure, a PID controller implemented in the PLC program will be used. The pressure is referenced to 6 bars and will be managed by the PID controller designed in the PLC program. The performance results of the PID controller can be displayed on the running screen for different values of the controller parameters.

articleTitle: Visual Cryptography and Blockchain for Protecting Against Phishing Attacks on Electronic Voting Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: A recent poll suggests that a lot of people don’t vote because they feel like they already have too much to do. This is because of many things, like the fact that everyone has to go to a polling place, wait in a long line, and be mentally and physically tired before they can vote. We have pushed for people to be able to vote online, but there are a growing number of problems and risks that could come with this. When websites are attacked by things like phishing, it might be hard to log in. With the help of Visual Cryptography (VC), We proposed Visual Cryptography and Blockchain for Protecting Against Phishing Attacks on Electronic Voting Systems we made a voting system that lets people discuss and decide on important business ideas without giving away any information.

articleTitle: Influence of Brush Positioning on Separately Excited DC Motor Operation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: In DC machines the brush collector system is considered to be a critical system to their operation. Improper positioning of the brushes can lead to malfunction or improper operation. This paper analyses the operation of a very low power DC motor when the brushes are placed in the geometrically neutral axis and when they can move at an angle between ± 10 ° and ± 20 ° to this axis. During motor tests, we determined the the speeds corresponding to the different brush positions, the waveforms of the supply voltage and the current in the winding of the armature were analysed, the torques for different loads of the armature were determined and the mechanical characteristics were constructed. The motor under analysis is part of a teaching test bench, therefore the strengths of the DC motor test bench with separate excitation winding were highlighted and solutions for its modernization were proposed. The analysis shows that the position of the brushes influences the speed and torque of the motor, and a proper positioning of the brushes can lead to an operation without large variations in current and torque.

articleTitle: Medium Voltage Network Modeling for the Integration of Renewable Sources
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The connection of photovoltaic parks to the distribution network has become an increasingly widespread phenomenon in recent years due to the increase in the efficiency of photovoltaic panels and the incentives given to the production of electricity from renewable sources. This phenomenon brings with it a series of challenges regarding the optimal solution for connecting to the network both in terms of compliance with power losses values and voltage values in the network nodes within the allowable limits, but also in terms of network reliability. The paper presents a case study regarding the connection of a 4 MW photovoltaic park to a 20 kV distribution network. The network was modeled using the dedicated DigSILENT software because it offers both technical solutions resulting from performing classic power flows, related to the different operating regimes of the network, and reliability solutions. These refer on the one hand to the network (SAIFI, SAIDI, ENS, ASIFI), and on the other hand to consumers (AIF, LPIF and LPIT). Comparatively, 3 solutions for connecting the photovoltaic park to the medium voltage network are presented and conclusions are formulated.

articleTitle: Power Quality Indicators Monitoring With SENTRON PAC4200
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: In this paper the authors present the study of a SENTRON PAC4200 (from Siemens) measuring station, which is used for the acquisition, display and monitoring of the power quality indicators of various consumers, useful for engineers and master’s students in the field of electrical engineering. Some theoretical aspects about the measuring station, the Powerconfig application and the related quality indicators are presented. Thus, through case studies, we test the performance of this measurement system and the possibility of integrating it into a power management system using industrial communication.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of the Nominal Current on the Torque and Respectively on the Efficiency for the BLDC Motor with Variable Geometry
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper aims to study the influence of the nominal current and current RMS on the torque and efficiency parameters of a brushless direct current - BLDC motor with variable geometry in the two extreme geometric instances, named Geom 0 - undeformed and Geom 10 - totally deformed. The stator and rotor geometries are modeled only to be able to extract some data from FEM simulations and are not optimized according to all the rules and design principles of BLDC electric machines, because the comparison in between the behaviors of different geometric instances is the purpose of the present study. The rotor is with variable geometry due to specific design of permanent magnets named compound magnets which are elastics.

articleTitle: Improved Partial Discharge Signals Analysis Using Discrete Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: It is well known that during the operating life of high voltage (HV) equipments, the insulating materials of which they consist are subjected to structural changes, which can lead to the degradation of insulation properties. Early detection of these changes in insulation allows by adequate maintenance the extension of the life of HV equipment. By partial discharge (PD) detection, it is possible to determine how damaging these changes are to the insulation of HV equipment. Thus, this article presents the phenomena and steps by which measurements for PD detection can be performed. It also presents the analysis and filtering using Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) features, which are superior to conventional filtering methods, for signals describing the main characteristics occurring in PD. In addition, experimental tests performed on some of equipments and measurement schemes suitable for PD determination and analysis are also presented.

articleTitle: Learning PLC-based Automation by Using an Educational Elevator
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Laboratory experiments provide substantial understanding and quantitative information about a series of actions or steps involved in that direction of engineering. The laboratories of engineering are key spaces, students thus learning to integrate theory and practice, to solve problems and apply experimental methods. One of the most popular training systems in engineering laboratories of electrical and control systems is the educational elevator, designed for the formation of basic skills and related specialist knowledge to electric drives and automation systems. The paper presents and discuss one upgraded educational elevator system in order to offer the possibility apply various control methods by means of the hardware controllers and to implement various control strategies.

articleTitle: Study of the Electromagnetic Field Generated by Wireless Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to outline the issue of exposure to electromagnetic radiation from communication systems (wireless routers, mobile phones) and to assess the intensity of the electric field to meet the levels within the limits imposed by law. The theme is a topical one because we use and are close to these devices every day, being exposed to the electromagnetic field both those who use the equipment and those who are close to it, lately this field being more and more publicized with the technological progress. Two generations of wireless routers were analyzed tracking electromagnetic field emissions depending on the position and number of users, this being done for mobile phones. A receiver microstrip antenna was also implemented to compare the results. The results obtained by experimental measurements, numerical modeling is presented and analyzed in this paper.

articleTitle: Six-phase Fractional Slot Concentrated Winding Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor with Reduced Torque Ripple
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: A comparative study on a fractional slot concentrated winding permanent magnet synchronous motor with 10 rotor poles and 12 stator coils connected in different arrangements and supplied from a six-phase inverter is presented in this paper. The aim of this investigation is to reduce the torque ripple of the machine by using the appropriate winding connection and power supply unit.

articleTitle: Assessment of Extremely Low-Frequency Magnetic Field from Multiple High-Voltage Overhead Power Lines in Parallel Configuration
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The study investigates the distribution of the extremely low-frequency magnetic field around multiple highvoltage overhead power lines in parallel configuration. It is conducted using a computation approach based on the finite element method for an arrangement of five 110-kV doublecircuit lines located in a suburban area of the Iasi city, Romania. Results obtained by numerical simulation are then compared to appropriate regulations regarding human exposure to magnetic fields. The cumulative effect of the magnetic fields from multiple overhead power lines is also discussed.

articleTitle: Protected Supply of Control Circuit for Standalone IoT Applications in Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper shows a circuit concept that can be used for supplying and protecting low power and low voltage self-powered devices which are employed in automation scenarios specific to Internet of Things (IoT). The proposed architecture consists of photovoltaic panels, a battery system, the protection circuit as well as an IoT device, thus allowing for independent control and measurement of various processes that are present in renewable-only microgrid applications.

articleTitle: Using IoT in Smart Agriculture: Study about Practical Realizations and Testing in a Real Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The Smart Agriculture concept has emerged as a solution to provide a decision support system for farm management. Although extensive research has been done in this field, many solutions involve substantial costs and are not feasible for small farms. The development of communication technologies and the accessibility of internet connections facilitate the production of cheap IoT nodes for agriculture. This paper presents a method for creating cheap IoT sensors that can be realized in a hobby manner, such that the data storage and processing steps do not involve supplementary costs. We checked the feasibility and viability of the proposed solution in practice by making the sensors and exposing them to real environmental operating conditions during a period of 6 months. We identified several problems related to the operation of the IoT nodes, tested multiple solutions and constructed a feasible system for data collection and storage for smart agriculture.

articleTitle: Dynamic Rating Technology Approach for Real-Time Monitoring of Overhead Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Current paper introduces the Romanian innovative solution for online monitoring system of high voltage overhead power lines, a smart grid technology.The online monitoring system uses sensors for online measurement of power line operating parameters (conductor current, conductor tilt angle/sag, conductor mechanical tension, conductor temperature, tower inclination, conductor oscillations, etc.) and ambient weather parameters (solar irradiation, environment temperature, wind speed and direction), for optimization of the high-voltage electrical network by using DLR (dynamic line rating) application. The paper describes the hardware of the OHLM system, emphasizing also on the developed software.

articleTitle: Framework for distribution network modelling and fault simulation using MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Multiple distribution network models have been developed and made openly available in recent years to examine the challenges faced by grid operators. Models common to North America or the United Kingdom do not highlight aspects of grid operation and construction specific to Eastern Europe. This paper provides guidance on how to model a real distribution network with resonant grounding from Romania and how to simulate simultaneous faults using the MATLAB/Simulink environment. Additionally, this paper addresses specific challenges, such as neutral grounding using either a grounding transformer with windings connected in zigzag or an artificial zigzag coil. The purpose of this paper is to provide a framework that lays the groundwork for researchers and grid operators for further distribution network analysis.

articleTitle: Practical Implementation of an Electronic Controlled Actuator for Micro Wind Turbine Overspeed Protection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: In this paper, an electronic device for furling control of a micro wind turbine is being presented. The electronic circuit has an analog implementation, to provide robustness and a relative accessible troubleshooting. The presented device monitors the output voltage of the turbine which, in turn, is proportional to the wind speed. By implementing a hysteresis – based control, the proposed circuit will observe if the generated voltage is outside the predefined threshold and, if needed, drive an actuator to furl the wind turbine out of the wind.

articleTitle: Study of Conduction Emissions of Household Appliances
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper aims to determine and reduce emissions through conduction in the supply networks of household appliances. In order to be able to suppress these emissions, it was necessary to test the level of disturbances emitted by conduction in the supply network, both by numerical modelling and by tests performed in the laboratory. Numerical modelling of the filters was necessary in choosing a filter corresponding to the tested devices. Using the results obtained from the test of the disturbances performed in the supply network, the filter was optimized to suppress these disturbances, so that the analysed equipment complies with the standard SR EN 55014-1 Electromagnetic compatibility - Requirements for household appliances, power tools and similar appliances.

articleTitle: Innovative integrated system for risk and lifetime management of power transformers in high voltage substation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Worldwide, the development of power systems took place mainly between 1960 and 1980, resulting in many components of power grids approaching their physical lifetime. Among these components, power transformers are very important due to their vital role in the transmission and distribution of electricity, respectively due to the increased operational risk.The paper presents the TRANSPOWER Digital Active Management system for the management of risks and the lifetime of high-voltage power transformers using the continuous online monitoring and diagnosis data.

articleTitle: SNR Measurement of Ionospheric Channels for Availability Evaluation under NVIS Propagation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: High frequency (HF) radio communications are used to transmit information over long distances. Since they are generally limited to narrow bandwidths and low transfer rates, techniques must be investigated to improve the capacity of HF communications. Estimating the signal-to-noise ratio indicates the reliability of the link between transmitter and receiver. In the design of adaptive systems, SNR estimation is commonly used to measure channel quality. This paper aims to present SNR variations over different time periods for ionospheric radio channels under Near Vertical Incidence Skywave (NVIS) propagation conditions using software defined radio (SDR) platforms.

articleTitle: Impact of Mechanical Inertia on the Power System Stability
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The equivalent inertia of power systems is decreasing due to the replacement of conventional power plants with renewable energy sources. This paper aims to determine and analyze the influence of low inertia on the power system transient stability. In particular, the influence on the critical fault clearing time is analyzed by considering different scenarios in order to better understand the impact of low inertia in power systems. Additionally, in this paper, the stability reserve for several scenarios will be computed and evaluated.

articleTitle: Neuro-fuzzy system for technical resilience assessment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Borrowed from psychology, the concept of the resilience of a technical system is defined by two inherent characteristics of the technical system: on the one hand, resistance to events that can produce defects and, secondly, the recovery of the functions for which it was created, as much as possible after the occurrence of a fault event. The current research focuses on the analysis of the resilience of a technical system (textile rolling machine) used as an evaluation indicator - the technical utility coefficient, and the generation of a fuzzy model for the analysis. The centralized data are obtained from 28 rolling machines located in 3 production units monitored over a period of one month, six days a week, 24 hours a day. During this time, data were recorded about the moments of appearance of the defects, the type of defect, the repair time, the production and the quality of the operations. The main objective of the work is to design a model based on artificial intelligence techniques for technical resilience and to identify a threshold for the resilience function (characterized by the technical utility parameter) of the technical system. The results of the paper are concretized by using a new indicator for evaluating technical resilience and determining maximum values for this characteristic using a neuro-fuzzy system.

articleTitle: Calibration of Temperature Indicators
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper refers to the evaluation of the uncertainty of measurement for the calibration of temperature indicators. The temperature gauge is a measuring instrument with analog or digital display used in conjunction with a temperature transducer to measure temperature. The device indicates the value of the temperature (in temperature units) derived from the measurement of an electrical quantity supplied by the transducer (electrical resistance or thermoelectric voltage). There is a particular reason for the evaluation of measurement uncertainty, as part of calibration, where the uncertainty of the measurement must be reported on the certificate. The calibration provides a relationship between the input and output signal of a measuring instrument. For the uncertainty of measurement evaluation, we must identify the sources of uncertainty in the measurement, estimate the contribution of the uncertainty from each source and finally to combine the individual uncertainties.

articleTitle: Evaluation and comparison of the performance of air conditioning systems from fully electric cars and cars with a thermal engine
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: From a chronological point of view, cars with a thermal engine are developed long before those with electric propulsion (EV). Among the many considerable differences between the two types of cars is the air conditioning system (HVAC). It is very well known that in electric cars the HVAC system is totally independent from the propulsion system and the current paper aims to evaluate the performance and compare the air conditioning systems present in these cars

articleTitle: Improving the Performances of Gas Sensors Using Metal Oxide Nanotubes with Oval Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper presents the results obtained from the researches upon a new category of gas sensors based on metal oxide materials in the form of oval nanotubes. The nanotubes are obtained by coating electrospinned nanofibers using magnetron sputtering thin film deposition techniques with metal oxides like zinc oxide (ZnO) and tin oxide (SnO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) deposed in various multilayers configurations, followed by appropriate calcination. The aim of the research is to find new possibilities of improving the metrological performances of the gas sensors, especially sensitivity, selectivity and power consumption by enlarging the contact surface between the measured gas and the active material and thus lowering the temperature at which the sensor nominally operates. The results reported in the paper show that, in comparison with classical metal oxide sensors, the new technique significantly increases the sensitivity at temperatures of 350-400<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">°</sup>C for certain configurations of oxide alternating multilayers.

articleTitle: Operation analysis of a three-phase induction motor with deep rotor bars and variable parameters
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper presents a mathematical model of the three-phase induction motor (IM), whose rotor construction involves the presence of a squirrel cage executed with deep bars (DB). The model, detailed in dynamic and steady-state forms, covers the operation of the induction motor, energized from a constant frequency supply. Besides the steady state regimes, the model covers the analysis of transient regimes, such as starting across the line with or without reduced voltage starters and changes in load torque. The dependency on the frequency of the rotor parameters is still a vivid subject for researchers, leading to the development of multiple models validated by experiments over the years. The derivation of the model from this paper starts from a well-known space phasor model, modified by introducing the rotor parameters referred to the stator $R^{\prime}2(\omega_{r}),L^{\prime}2\sigma(\omega_{2})$, as functions of the rotor frequency f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf>, and consequently of slip, because of the skin effect and local saturation of the rotor slot’s neck. Following such an assumption validated by the literature, one developed slip-dependent analytical expressions of the rotor parameters referred to as the stator. The modified model became the subject of simulations whose outcome is assessing the steady state and transient characteristics of an induction motor. The obtained results verify the conclusions from multiple bibliographical resources.

articleTitle: A Full State Feedback Approach to Designing Digital Cascade Control with PI Voltage and Peak Current Loops
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper presents an analytic model for the Peak Current Control, useable for the Buck or Boost power converters. The Peak Current Control is often used as an inner loop within a cascaded control composed of a PI outer voltage control loop and an inner Peak Current Control loop. The voltage loop cancels the steady-state error and ensures the dynamic requirements are met, while the current loop provides a very fast compensation of the current variations due to disturbation. This paper offers a novel design method for the cascaded control based on the State Space representation. The theory is accompanied with fine details revealed in MATLAB and PSIM analysis.

articleTitle: Web Tool for Evaluating Photovoltaic Opportunitie for Potential Prosumers
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper might be an impetus addressed to a wide range of possible beneficiaries or just stakeholders, from state authorities, to businesses and simple individuals, to contribute to the development of photovoltaic systems in Romania. To begin with, the main economic, strategic and environmental arguments that support the development of these systems, which can be effective in the areas of the Earth where 93% of its inhabitants live, are synthesized. It is shown that in terms of the total amount of solar energy received per square meter, for an entire year, Romania is on a modest 182-nd position. However, it is demonstrated by calculation that only by using 0.22% of the unpopulated and undamaged surface of our country for PV systems, the entire national electric energy requirement could be provided. A tool developed in Python that allows estimating the photovoltaic potential of the roof of a normal-sized residential building is presented in detail. Based on all the costs involved (both the investment effort and the subsidized or non-subsidized price of the kWh) an encouraging result is obtained regarding the recovery time of the invested money.

articleTitle: Internal Parameters Extraction Algorithm for Mono and Polycrystalline Photovoltaic Panels Using Single-Diode Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: In this article, an algorithm for determining the five unknown parameters of the single diode model of a photovoltaic (PV) panel using only the catalog data is established and verified. To illustrate the performance of the proposed algorithm, the five parameters are determined from the catalog data of different commercial PV panels. With thus determined parameters, the current-voltage (I-V) characteristics of the considered PV panels are constructed and these characteristics are compared with the manufacturer experimental I-V characteristics of the considered panels. The results of the performed comparisons show a good concordance between the calculated characteristics and the experimentally determined ones.

articleTitle: Extending the Control’s Number in Motor Imagery Based Brain-Computer Interfaces Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: A Brain - Computer Interface (BCI) is a direct communication pathway that is established between the brain and external devices. The most widely used BCI paradigms relying on EEG are: Motor Imagery, P300, SSVEP and Error-Related Potential. Motor imagery is the phenomenon of mentally repeating movements without actually executing them. Motor imagery disadvantage is that it can only generate a limited number of commands, namely two or three. This paper aims to identify and test a method to address the aforementioned limitation.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Fractional Slot Concentrated Wound Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machines with Different Stator Grain Oriented Electric Steel Lamination Topologies
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper aims to present a comparative FEM analysis between different stator topologies of permanent magnet synchronous machine (PMSM) with fractional slot concentrated wound (FSCW). The main topology difference consists in using two distinct materials for the stator core. The materials refer to non-oriented electric steel (NOES) and grain-oriented electric steel (GOES) lamination. Four stator topologies have been obtained by combining these materials. The first topology is strictly used as a comparison reference, the next two topologies approach a modular stator core, and the last one–a horseshoe bent strips core. Modular core construction simplifies the manufacturing technology and reduces the overall production costs without a significant impact on machine performance.

articleTitle: Experimental stand for wind energy conversion in electricity
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This article presents the study of the conversion of wind energy into electrical energy by means of an experimental stand designed to analyze the aerodynamics of a miniature horizontal axis wind turbine and the influence of some parameters on its performance such as: the influence of the angle of inclination of the wind turbine blades, as well as the influence of the number of blades on the power produced and the efficiency factor.The power generated by a wind turbine depends on the ability of the rotor to take as much energy as possible from the wind energy. This capacity depends directly on the angle of inclination of the rotor blades and the number of rotor blades. Following the practical experiments, analyzing the influence of the aerodynamic elements of the blades and the number of blades of the turbine, on the Power P and the efficiency factor Cp, we can conclude that the most efficient wind turbines with a horizontal axis are those with 3 blades, at the angle variable pitch between 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">°</sup>-10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">°</sup>, with narrow blade profile shape and narrow blade tip shape.

articleTitle: Design and Performances Evaluation of a PMSG used for Pico-Power Plant – a case study
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper proposes a specific permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) configuration dedicated for wind power applications. A pico-power plant is considered, for an isolated site, for which a defined energy is available for a monthly period, based on the available wind speed. The transition from a basic PMSG topology towards a final best suited structure is presented. The designed characteristics and performances are shown, as well as the numerical validation by means of finite element method. The obtained results prove the suitability of the designed PMSG for the considered application and the perspective of daily produced energy.

articleTitle: Photovoltaics as an Energetic Solution for a Commercial Building
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Building roofs are a good option for installing photovoltaic systems on them. So, the energy produced by the panels could cover a part or even the whole of the energy needed by the respective building. If the energy produced would exceed the energy demand, the surplus energy could be injected into the grid without any changes to the grid. In the present paper, a technical-economic study was carried out on the installation of a photovoltaic system on the roof of a commercial building. For a more accurate estimate of the electricity produced by the photovoltaic system, a shading study was carried out for the roof of the building. For this case study, it was observed that when shading is taken into account, the estimated energy is almost 11% lower than when shading is not considered. For the economic analysis, we started from the hypothesis that all the energy produced by the PV system will be injected into the electrical grid. Under these conditions, the beneficiary will recover his investment in approximately 7 years.

articleTitle: Technical Analysis Regarding The Implementation Of A Building Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The building management system (BMS) develops consumption management algorithms in real time, so that the most effective action is selected to meet the requirements of building users. Different strategic algorithms can be designed for to achieve different objectives based on sets of performance indicators, the result of which is the control of available resources and the variation of consumption characteristics to achieve optimal use of resources. The building management system will integrate into the system of energy management the most common, friendly, and frequently used communication device mobile phone. In this article, the building management system model was investigated through the lens of local energy production vs. energy consumption and their efficient correlation.

articleTitle: Conversion of Phase Shift into DC Voltage
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This article was based on the motivation that there is no such stand-alone device on the market, usually being included in a device of greater complexity. The paper presents the design stages and the results obtained by the practical realization of this instrument for measuring the phase shift between two quantities (for example a voltage and a current). The measurement of the phase shift or of the quantities that can be determined from it has a particular importance in the electricity transmission and distribution networks or in the testing phase of machines and electrical appliances. For their operation with maximum efficiency, it is desired that the power factor be in a continuous improvement (the power factor be as close as possible to the unit), i.e. to obtain a phase shift as close as possible to zero between current and voltage. Another application is to develop active or reactive power and energy meter in single or three phase power network.

articleTitle: Impact of Distributed Generation on the Performance of Electrical Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: In view of the contemporary needs of our society, the problems involving energy generation and its management have received special attention. Among the main objectives are the requirement to reduce greenhouse gas emissions from the burning of fossil fuels and the demand for electricity consumption worldwide. Renewable sources and distributed generation play an important role in this scenario. With the identification of the resources needed to produce electricity through their distributed generation sources, there are also challenges in terms of operating and maintaining optimal operating parameters. The paper presents the main effects of the integration of distributed generation technologies in an electrical network and analyzes through simulation and in the DigSilent Power Factory software, the evolution of active and reactive power losses.

articleTitle: Low-cost Laboratory Scanner Unit: Design and Testing for Hyperspectral Imaging System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Hyperspectral imaging is a technology that is increasingly used in various application areas such as product quality control, sorting, recycling, or vegetation studies, etc. Compared to information from conventional images (black and white or color), hyperspectral imaging provides important information on the chemical, physical or biological structure of products. For these objects to be scanned and analyzed in laboratory conditions or before making an industrial application they need to be scanned on a hyperspectral imaging system. These systems usually come at a very high price; an additional cost added to the hyperspectral camera itself. The objective of this paper is to design and implement a low-cost system with the same functionalities of an original one. Because the functionalities of a similar system resemble the one of a 3D printer and the chassis gives us the liberty to create supports for cameras, illumination, controllers, in this paper an old, decommissioned 3D printer (Anet A8 PLUS) was repurposed to create a hyperspectral imaging system.

articleTitle: Limitations of the Improved Ossart Model Applied to Non-Oriented Electrical Steel Sheets
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Soft magnetic materials are essential part in any electromagnetic devices. Non-oriented (N.O.) sheet are particularly used for electrical motors. Even though these devices usually operate at 50 Hz, it is sometimes important to have information about their behavior at other frequencies values. In this work, the characterization of a of 3 types set of sheets N.O. magnetic was performed. The purpose of this paper is to highlight the limitations of the Ossart model with respect to these types of magnetic materials. The experimental and modeled loops were compared for a range of frequencies from 10 to 200 Hz, establishing the boundaries of this model dedicated to the magnetic materials modeling. The analysis followed the relative errors between the areas of the experimental and generated (modeled) loops.

articleTitle: Modified Polynomial Method to Synthesize a Control Algorithm for a System with Second-Order Inertia and Time Delay
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper presents the procedure for tuning the PID controller to the object model with second-order inertia and time delay according to the method of the maximum degree of stability with iterations and the modified polynomial method. In industrial process automation, mathematical models attached to slow and very slow processes are approximated by mathematical model with second-order inertia and time delay. The modified polynomial method of tuning the PID algorithm to the control object model with first-order inertia and time delay is developed, which presents a simple procedure. To compare the obtained results, the method of the maximum degree of stability with iterations, the Ziegler-Nichols method of tuning the PID controller to the object model with second-order inertia and time delay is applied. Examples are examined and the results obtained when varying the parameters of the object model are analyzed. The advantages of the maximum degree of stability method with iterations and modified polynomial method are highlighted.

Author Keywords: object model with second-order inertia and time delay
maximum degree of stability method with iterations

articleTitle: Compression Of Acquired Data In Order To Make Transmission And Processing More Efficient
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The article below briefly presents the subject of lossy compression for various types of sensor acquired data. The type and amount of data from the transmission line sensor network will be analyzed, the data compression algorithms will be compared, and a proposed efficient lossy compression algorithm suitable for transmission line data will be favored. It presents what is currently in use on the market.

articleTitle: Wireless Power Transfer Systems Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to optimize the wireless power transfer system (WPTS) by using magnetic couplings. By optimizing the system, it results an improvement for the active power transmitted to the load and its transmission efficiency for WPTS used to charge/recharge for example, the batteries of electric vehicles. To deduce the dependence of WPTS performance on the number of magnetic couplings and the parameter values of the coupled coils, we analyzed: the effect of reducing the losses (resistances) of intermediate circuits on the active power values transmitted to the load and on the power transfer efficiency values. As a case study, a WPTS with six magnetic couplings were compared to three magnetic couplings. The optimization algorithms presented in this paper are suitable for calculating the optimal parameters of the WPTS equivalent circuit. In this way, the minimum and maximum performance values are obtained. The proposed optimization techniques were tested and validated with simulation data on several illustrative examples.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of a Commercial PV/T in MATLAB/Simulink Software Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Modeling and simulation analysis of commercial PV/T panels is increasingly used and appreciated, in terms of the research and development environment in the field of energy. This approach based on the MATLAB/Simulink modelling strategy applied to most of hybrid systems has shown that it is a particularly useful multifunctional tool. Based on the electrical and thermal characteristics taken from the data sheet of the PIKCELL Solar Power manufacturer, for the photovoltaic/thermal hybrid module proposed PV/T280W, the model is implemented and simulated in the MATLAB/Simulink environment in the beginning under standard test conditions and subsequently under imposed conditions of temperature and irradiance measured in real conditions. In this research is presented the simulation results in the MATLAB/Simulink program of the photovoltaic/thermal hybrid module, for an analysis of the electrical and thermal performances, but also for the analysis of these performances at the operation of the module in the standard and real conditions described.

articleTitle: Composites with Nano Conductive Channels Architecture Uniformly Distributed Through the Thickness of the Material and Oriented in the Magnetic Field
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The total resistance of a composite material can be determined by considering two factors: the number of current paths and the average resistivity of the paths, and as the number of current paths increases, the total resistance of the material decreases. The article proposes a composite material based on Fe/Al nanoparticles oriented in a magnetic field and exposed to IR/UV radiation. These composite materials, based on a PDMS-type polymer matrix, were tested optically, dielectrically and electrical resistively.

Author Keywords: alignment of particles in magnetic field

articleTitle: Extracting and Determining Respiratory Variation by Processing Force Sensor and PPG Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Respiratory variation (RV) is a typical physiological parameter used in clinical setups to check patient conditions. The RV is used in a variety of clinical scenarios and as the number of patients increases there is an urgent need for monitoring via wearable sensors, which means that it must be possible to robustly estimate RV from the outputs of these sensors. Within this research paper we propose to extract and determine the RV from two type of sensors: force sensor and photoplethysmography (PPG) sensor by applying filters and different types of processing techniques. The raw data that have been used to determine RV level were acquired by using the proposed data acquisition system.

articleTitle: Assessment of Distance Learning/Teaching Techniques in Engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The electromagnetic theory has established state-of-the-art electrical engineering applications. Therefore, this aspect must be advertised to students to motivate them in their careers. This work presents the conceptualization and development of a virtual environment based on Unity3D. The virtual environment is used as a didactic strategy to teach electromagnetism to undergraduate students. The characteristics of the proposed virtual environment and its assessment are described. Finally, the evaluation of the impressions and opinions of the students are presented.

articleTitle: Brain-Computer Interface Based Control for a Humanoid Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Is it possible to use a humanoid robot to assist disabled patients? This paper aims to answer that question and come up with an application that addresses this idea employing a Brain-Computer Interface. It investigates the different facets of such an application in terms of its complexity. The results shown by the laboratory tests (e.g. a 96% average BCI accuracy to define planned controls for the humanoid robot) are really promising for future research.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Distributed Winding and Fractional Slot Winding on High Power Synchronous Hydro-Generators
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper aims to present the possibility to adopt on high power synchronous hydro-generators of the fractional slot winding structure instead of the classical distributed winding. The fractional slot machine can be obtained by using the concentric coils on the stator teeth that offer copper economy and constructive simplicity. One comparative analysis is presented in this paper which evaluates the physical construction and electrical performance of these two structures: distributed winding with Z=72 slots and 6 rotor poles and fractional slot machine with Z=9 slots and 2p=6 rotor poles.

articleTitle: Adequacy evaluation of power generating systems taking into account the power reserves requirements
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The need of power operating reserves for frequency-power control in power generation systems has become a hot topic caused by the growing penetration of renewable energy, new storage systems, controllable loads and power electronics technologies. This paper addresses the operating reserves in the evaluation of system adequacy. The adequacy indices are evaluated with the help of sequential Monte Carlo method. Scenarios with different generating units are analyzed and the appropriate sources are selected to meet the power reserve requirements while maintaining the same level of adequacy.

articleTitle: The Use Of Laser Technology For Recycling Hybrid Electronic Waste
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The worldwide amount of hybrid materials waste, especially of electronic waste, has continually increased over the last years. Society and industry need new solutions and technologies for recycling these types of materials and components. Particularly electronic waste contains a considerable quantity of noble metals, which can be reused in different applications several times. For this purpose, the hybrid materials must be separated into their individual components to be properly recycled. The laser technology offers great potential for separating the individual materials of different hybrid components, which can be effective solution for different products. This paper presents a scientific study of hybrid materials separation by laser.

articleTitle: Video Distance Measurement Method Based on the Weighted Average of the Depth Intervals Centers
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: In literature, there are two methods of distance measurement using video cameras: active and passive. Active methods use additional hardware to emit light beams from various configurations, and passive methods use light from the camera’s lens. Passive methods may use one or more camcorders. In the latter case, detection methods of an object are known based on the correlation with the focusing position of the focus lens and the identification of the image with maximum clarity. This article highlights solving some problems in this field by increasing the number of calibration states compared to the number of steps the focus lens can perform and implicitly increasing the measurement accuracy. The distance measurement method based on weighted average, according to the study conducted, comprises a calibration stage and a measurement stage.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Performances Evaluation of High-Speed Synchronouse Reluctance Machines for Turbo-Charger Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical And Power Engineering (EPE)
